 2026 season · Week 8 Southern Miss Golden Eagles Playoff Chances

It has less than a 1% chance to be the highest-ranked Group of 6 team, which earns an automatic bid. Projected regular-season wins: 2.9.

 About the A to Z Sports CFB Playoff Predictor
 The A to Z Sports CFB Playoff Predictor: every FBS team's path to the 2026 College Football Playoff. It gives all 138 FBS teams their odds to make the 12-team playoff, win their conference, earn a first-round bye and win the national title, from 6,000 simulations of the rest of the season. Pick the winner of any game and every team's odds update, with each conference's official tiebreakers and the 2026 CFP format applied. Every team has a page with what it needs and who to root for, and you can build, download and share your own bracket. Free to use. No account needed.
 Last updated October 23, 2026 · results through Thu, Oct 22 · based on 6,000 simulated seasons.
 How to use the College Football Playoff Predictor
 See every team's odds. We simulate the rest of the season thousands of times and count how often each team makes the 12-team playoff.
 Pick any game. Tap a team to make them the winner. Both teams' strength updates the way it would after a real result, and every team's odds update nationwide.
 Sim the rest. Use "Sim this week" or "Sim to Selection Day" — your picks stay locked.
 Pick the title games. "Title games" (after the last week) shows each conference's likely championship matchups. Pick a winner — the pick follows that team if it gets there.
 Make the bracket yours. Your picks shape the projected bracket — tap See the Bracket on any page. Tap any team to send it through, or edit the 12 to swap in any team. It follows the 2026 rules, so every Power 4 champion and the top Group of 6 team stay in.
 Go deeper. Conference pages apply each league's official tiebreakers. Team pages show what your team needs and who to root for.
 Share it. Copy a link to your scenario, or download a ready-to-post graphic of your team's odds, the projected 12-team field or your bracket.
 Frequently asked questions
 What are Southern Miss's chances to make the College Football Playoff? Less than a 1% chance, according to the A to Z Sports model (6,000 simulated seasons, updated October 23, 2026). The Southern Miss Golden Eagles are 1-5 (0-2 in the Sun Belt). Chance to be the top-ranked Group of 6 team, which gets an automatic bid: less than 1%. Chance to win the national title: less than 1%.
 What does Southern Miss need to make the playoff? Southern Miss makes the playoff in less than 1% of simulated seasons. Even at 6-6, it gets in less than 1% of the time.
 Who should Southern Miss fans root for? No single result elsewhere moves Southern Miss's playoff odds by a full point right now — Southern Miss's own games matter most.
 Can Southern Miss win the Sun Belt? Southern Miss reaches the Sun Belt Championship in 1% of simulated seasons and wins the conference in less than 1%. Ties for a title-game spot are broken with the Sun Belt's official tiebreakers.
